content: Yelusalende Hui Keizho
Yudayase bouzhesan giedun kunla gaijiulade Musani guijinghala hetoune ulie giese jiui dane giezhi sughazho.
BaoloBanabaghala hhelare hende jianjiduzhi zhenjinduse jiohuini kunla Baolo, Banaba, pse giedun kunlai ene shiqinde Yelusalenni shitu, zhanlaolade asaghale echine giezhi jiejin giewo.
Ingiese jiohuini kunla hhelai khughowo. Hhela Feiniji, Samaliyani daokude niman kunla Ersai xianxin giesei kieliese hhendedu gaijiula man hende bayasuzho.
Yelusalende kuruse shitu, zhanlao, jiohuini kunla hhelai jienliewo. Huda hhelare hhantu giesan shiqinlai man jiohuini kunlade kieliewo.
Giedun Falisai paini Ersai xianxin giesan kunla bosizhedene kieliewo, "Niman kunlai bixi hetoune gieghadene fenfulazhi Musani guijinni zunjighakuni wo."
Shitu, zhanlaola hhantulazhi ene shiqinni shanlian giewo.
Dajiala ene shiqinni oloncha jianjidudene Beduru bosizhe kieliewo, "Gaijiula, Huda melieshida tani dundase mii sunghuzhi niman kunla mase gouxioxini chenliedene xianxin giesei ta mejiene.
Kunyi zhugheni mejiechen Huda matande ogisan mutun niman kunladeye Shenlinni ogizhi hhelai jienliewo.
Dou xianxin giekughala hhelani zhughei ganjinraghawo. Hhelai uzheku matanre niekielien wo.
Ede ta yale Hudai shiizhi matan, matanyi xienrenla lai daku jiabanni tujilai ghuzhun jiere zhoghane?
Ulie olune, matanyi jiuikushi Ezhan Ersai nenjienghala wo. Hhelaye niekielien wo. Bijien ingiezhi xianxin giezho."
Olon kunla man yama shenqi uye khizhezhi Huda BanabaBaologhalai tungo giezhi niman kunlai dunda giesan ghudureqi, fugie shiqinlai chenliezho.
Hhela kielie baludene Yagebu kieliewo, "Gaijiula, mii kielienyi chenliendu.
Huda matugiezhi niman kunlai zhaogu giezhi tou 1 hui hhelani dundase bexinlai sunghudene goyanughun gholughasei Ximien
kieliewo.
Eneshi xienzhila kieliesan kielienghala niekielien wo. Jinwun jiere huaizho,

content.text: Ingiese feiliesan kunlai man Ezhanyi ereighane.
Bi sunghuzhi goyanughun gholughasan niman kunlai man Ezhanyi ereighane.

content: Ingiese bi uzhese Hudade shunjisan niman kunlade chijia bu teidene
hhelade xin huaizhi nigiedade ogidene zannanshisan, lon kijieku, lei alasan, chusun, enelase gholodo giezhi fenfulase oluzho.
Ingiekushi eqighanse izhi go chenshide Musani guijinni jianjichen kun wine. Niefanie hhamuraku udude huitande onshizho."
Xianxin Giesan Niman Kunlade Xin Huaizho

Ingiedene shitu, zhanlao, jiohuini kunla hhelai dundase kun sunghuzhi Baolo, Banabare hhantu Anqiyade echighane giezhi jiejin giewo. Sunghusan kunshi Basaba giesan Yuda, pse Seila wo. Ene ghualashi jiohuini zhanlao wo.
Ingie hhelade bareighasan xin jiere kieliezho, "Ersai sudoro gaijiu danlasan shitu, zhanlaola Anqiya, Xiliya, Jilijiadedu xianxin giesan niman gaijiulade kielien asazho."
"Bijien sonosuse bijienni enense giedun kun khizhi echi kielienghala tai jiohoro giezhi tande nanran ese ogizho. Shijishan bijien hhelade yama ese fenfulazho.
Ingie dajiala tunyigie giedun kun sunghu peizhi bijien oresan Banaba, Baolore hhantu tai hhende echighawo.
Ene ghualashi mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihade oluzhi aminne ulie kerechen kun wo.
Ingiese bijien Yuda, Seilaghalai peizhi tande qinsi ene shiqinlai kielieghane.
Shenlin bijienre hhantu tunyi giezhi ene giedun zhunyoni shiqinse chugo psedu achanni tai jiere ulie teise gou wo giezho.
Ta nigiedade teisan, chusun, lei alasan, lon kijieku enelase gholoduse jiu oluwo. Tande salan gieye."
Hhelani peizhi Anqiyade bou, xianxin giesan kunlai uruzhi hhantulagha xinni jiuizhi ogiwo.
Xinni onshidene zhichi giesan goushi hhela bayasuzho.
Yuda, Seilaghalashiye xienzhi wo. Olon kielienghala gaijiulade surughazhi hhelai xianxin giekuni khiduzheghawo.
Hhela hhende nietan soudene gaijiula hhelai dafalazhi hhelai peizhi ireghasan Yelusalenni jiohuide pinnande echighawo.
Baolo, Banabaghala Anqiyade zhanshi souzhi olon kunlare hhantu kunlade sughazhi Ezhanyi kielienyi chonjizho.
Baolo Banabaghala Ghaghachazho
Giedudu daodene BaoloBanabade kieliewo, "Matan khareizhi eqighandei Ezhanni kielienyi chonjisan go chenshide gaijiulani qinkonyi uzhele yoye."
BanabaMake giesan Yaheiyani uduruzhi echine giese
Make eqighandei Panfeiliyase likai giezhi hhelare hhantu wilie ese giewo giezhi Baolo hhei jiedui ulie udurune giezho.
Ingie ghuala hende jianjindu ghaghachawo. BanabaMakei uduru chon soudene Saipuluside echiwo.
BaoloSeilai sunghusenu gaijiula hhelai Ezhanni nenjiende jiuizhi ogise yo qiiwo.
BaoloXiliyani, Jilijiani yozhi go jiohuilani khiduzheghawo.
